# routeur_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up a workspace by `slug` or `id` — for example to pass an existing workspace's id as `workspace_id`. A workspace: the default scope for routing rules and policies. Creating one also creates its default project and its Default route; deleting it removes them too. A workspace created through the API (and so by Terraform) gets a default project with the slug `<workspace slug>-core`; the workspace an organisation starts with has one called `core`. Refer to the default project by `default_project_id` (or the `routeur_project` data source with that id) rather than by guessing its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organisation's default workspace, created at sign-up.
data "routeur_workspace" "default" {
  slug = "default"
}

resource "routeur_project" "batch" {
  workspace_id = data.routeur_workspace.default.id
  slug         = "batch-jobs"
  name         = "Batch jobs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Public id of the workspace (`ws_…`). Pass it as `workspace_id` to resources that live in the workspace. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The workspace's slug, unique in the organisation. Set exactly one of `id` and `slug`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `default_project_id` (String) Id of the workspace's default project (`proj_…`): where a new API key lands when it names no project. Null only for a workspace that has none.
- `description` (String) Free-text description, at most 255 characters. Stored verbatim; `""` stays `""`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organisation's default workspace, which cannot be deleted.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
